Horsemanship: Rear Maneuver
Command your horse to rear up on its hind legs and strike with its front hooves.
Controls: Bring your horse to a complete stop and press the Rear key.
Combat & Collision: The horse's hooves strike and push anyone standing directly in front of you.
Notes: - Consumes horse stamina. - Subject to a recovery cooldown once it lands on someone, shown as an icon while it lasts. - Warning: Striking innocent bystanders is considered a crime.

Horsemanship: Rear Charge
Launch an explosive forward charge out of a rear, bowling over and trampling opponents.
Controls: Bring your horse to a complete stop and press the Rear Charge key.
Combat & Collision: The horse lunges forward with violent momentum, trampling anyone in its path.
Notes: - Consumes horse stamina. - Subject to a long recovery cooldown once it lands on someone, shown as an icon while it lasts. - Warning: Trampling innocent civilians will alert guards and incur a bounty.
